changelog._note: pip/PyPI has no standardized hosted changelog convention. url_template points at the same PyPI JSON API response registry_api uses (info.project_urls often has a Changelog/Repository key) rather than a real changelog page, and version_header_regex deliberately never matches, so fetch_updates.py's documented fallback ('could not parse, see changelog_url') fires for every package here -- read info.project_urls from the registry_api response by hand instead when grading a candidate.
